name: Pip
self_text: Hi! I'm Pip, a non-binary Italian in my mid 30s. I studied economics and in my free time I love playing chess online because it keeps my mind sharp. Currently, I am studying language practice. Regarding how I work, I find that I work best with studying independently side by side. I am flexible with where we meet, as I can meet in person or online. As for my availability, I am free Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into language practice. It would be nice if you are available Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or Sunday morning, and it's a small bonus if you are into studying independently side by side.
